messages:
anil: Heads-up — seeing a spike in audit-exporter queue length in ap-south, and several GPU node joins failing with keystore decrypt timeouts. Happening since the egress-shaper rollout last night?
maya: ops-bot fired an alert at 03:12UTC, `audit-exporter.queue > 1000` 
ops-bot: Alert: audit-exporter queue length = 2142 (threshold 500). Top consumer: keystore-proxy (ap-south-2).
liz: Confirmed. Onboarding logs show repeated `KMS_DECRYPT_TIMEOUT` and S3 audit sink requeues. Sample from node-ax12:
```
2026-03-21T03:09:47Z keystore-proxy[warn] decrypt failed: timeout after 10s
2026-03-21T03:09:47Z audit-exporter[err] enqueue failed: upstream rate limit (503)
```
sam: The egress-shaper changed per-team CIDR policing and added a 10Mbps cap to the audit-exporter subnets. That cap looks like it could be killing streaming to the SIEM and choking the keystore proxy fallback paths.
jordan: If the exporter stalls, keystore calls pile up and KMS proxy retries amplify. We saw a similar amplification loop in eu-west last year.
anil: Can we revert the shaper quickly for ap-south and measure queue delta? If revert not instant, we should throttle keystore-proxy concurrency as a stopgap.
maya: Revert request: filed with networking (ticket #NET-5123) — will attempt rollback in 5 mins, ETA 10. Meanwhile I'll lower keystore-proxy workers from 12 -> 4 on the affected nodes.
ops-bot: Change scheduled: NET-5123 egress-shaper rollback (ap-south) requested by maya — pending approval.
liz: Lowering workers now on node-ax12 and node-ax13. Watch logs for decreased KMS_queued.
(2m later)
liz: Quick metrics: audit-exporter queue down to ~800 after worker drop, KMS decrypt errors rate halved. Still above normal.
sam: If rollback goes through, we should also bump the SIEM ingest rate temporarily to catch up (add burst QPS to S3 sink). Need ops approval.
jordan: +1 on temporary burst. Also propose we add a safeguard in the shaper rollout playbook: allow-list audit-exporter CIDR with emergency burst token, and a k8s health-probe for keystore decrypt latency so autoscaler can react.
anil: Agreed — postmortem action items: 1) rollback egress-shaper for ap-south (in-flight), 2) add allow-list/burst to shaper playbook, 3) implement keystore decrypt latency probe + autoscaler policy, 4) run chaos test for keystore+exporter under egress cap. I'll open a short runbook PR for the immediate steps.
maya: NET team rolled back at 03:25UTC — ops-bot shows queue dropping to 230 now, nodes resumed warmup. Marking incident as mitigated but keeping watch for 2 hours. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident update: mitigated — egress-shaper rollback confirmed.
anil: Thanks everyone. We'll follow up with a blameless postmortem and add the shaper exception.
maya: Adding notes to NET-5123 and will loop in security for audit retention impact.
liz: Leaving logs/snippets in the incident doc: https://redwood-internal/incident/3967000123 — includes `kubectl` snippets and prometheus graphs.
anil: Good. If anyone sees recurring KMS timeouts after recovery, ping me.
